Pixel OS v1.6.6 — 1:1 iOS 26 Control Center + Settings (Jetpack Compose) on Android 17 for Realme X2 Pro (RMX1931)
• Adds standalone 1:1 iOS 26 Liquid Glass Control Center (IosControlCenter.apk) triggered from the top-right status bar with zero modifications to stock SystemUI: 2×2 Connectivity & Now Playing platters, vertical Brightness & Volume capsules, Clear vs Tinted optics, Ambient Rain synthesizer, 90Hz/DC Dimming/Torch/Focus controls, and Power Menu
• Wires Settings -> Control Center (Access Within Apps, Access on Lock Screen, Open Control Center) and long-press tile deep links into 1:1 IosSettings
• Preserves pristine stock Android 17 SystemUI Notification Shade (left/center swipe), QuickStep Recents, 90Hz Liquid Glass Dock, iOS 26 Icons, iCall 26 Phone & Liquid Glass Messages
